property_summary: setL1BlockValues is atomic: either it succeeds and all public fields equal the inputs, or it reverts and none of the public fields change.

Calling setL1BlockValues from a non-depositor address must revert and must not change any of C's public fields; when called by the depositor address it must succeed and set all public fields to the provided inputs.
If setL1BlockValues succeeds (does not revert), then each public getter equals the corresponding input; otherwise (if it reverts) none of the public getters change.

When setL1BlockValues is called by this test contract it must either revert (leaving all public getters unchanged) or succeed and set every public getter exactly to the provided inputs; there is no other reachable outcome.
Only calls to setL1BlockValues from the depositor address succeed; calls from other callers must revert and must not change any public storage values.
